name: Ascension Academy
creator: Lnik Forstruth
description: Ascension Academy is a large fantasy-themed roleplay map created by Lnik Forstruth, built as the setting for the Ascension Academy RP series organized by StealthRG (Chipz). Within the fiction of the roleplay, it depicts a military academy that trains cadets in magic, weaponry, and tactics; as a physical VRChat map it provides the classrooms, halls, and grounds used by that community's ongoing storylines. It stands out as one of the more elaborate purpose-built roleplay campuses documented on the wiki.
